title_draft: Does Zad Archery Demo Progress Carry Over?
quick_answer_draft: No. Samharia Studios said the full game changed significantly from the demo, so demo save data cannot carry into the release version. The old demo remains available through itch.io.

claims.text: The developer directly said demo save data cannot carry because the game changed a lot from the demo.

sections.h2: Can you still play the demo?

claims.text: The developer said the Steam demo was removed but the demo can still be found on itch.io.

sections.h2: Why the full game is different

claims.text: The demo store description said the demo covered early job classes, four skills, loot/items and crafting, while the full version added more jobs, 15+ additional skills and deeper systems.
